steps.name: Curi Curi Curiring (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Atkina] in "Dragon Valley", then defeat [Oblivious Curiring] in "Phobos" and obtain an <Obedient Curiring>. Then report to [Atkina] in "Dragon Valley".

lines.text: (On a warm, sunlit afternoon, the Dragon Valley seems unusually busy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look busy, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Do I? If it looks that way to you, I suppose I must be.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: New phantom beasts will soon be born in this valley. I'm making preparations.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: First, I did some cleaning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were cleaning? Without even a broom?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha. You were thinking of ordinary cleaning. My method is a little different.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I return to my true form and rise into the sky. Then, with my wingbeats, I spread the energy the goddess gave me throughout Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. You're a dragon.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even I sometimes feel strange returning to my true form. I've grown accustomed to this appearance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can help with? It feels awkward to just sit around resting...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You always spend your time helping others. Ah, something comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You've seen the Curirings in Phobos, haven't you? They evolved from Prirings, ordinary creatures of our world.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They were beloved by the god in the beginning, and developed many different forms. They seem surprisingly susceptible to their surroundings.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Those that grow fond of money can even become as worldly as humans...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Curirings were probably ordinary Prirings once, too. Someone may have taken them for their cuteness, or they may have fallen through a rift into the Demon Realm and become demonic while living there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can they return to their original forms?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If exposed to energy stronger than that of the place that made them demonic, yes. Ah, that may work.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: When phantom beasts are born, Adrica fills with clear, pure energy. If we bring Curirings here to live, they may be freed of their demonic nature.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Curirings...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please rescue some of the Curirings commonly seen in Phobos and bring them here.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Here, take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A sort of magical sack that phantom beasts enjoy. Animals beloved by the god like to climb inside. Even a large one like a Sequentia will disappear from sight inside it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What an amazing item.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The Curirings will be drawn to its mysterious energy and climb in on their own. Bring about twenty first so we can observe them. We can bring more later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go fetch the Curirings.

steps.name: Curi Curi Curiring (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Gentle Curiring] and [Idol Curiring] in "Rosengarten" to obtain a <Rescued Curiring> and a <Hungry Curiring>. Then report to [Atkina] in "Dragon Valley".

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Well done. Were the little Curirings fierce?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not so much fierce. They kept rushing at me as though they wanted affection. It was quite a handful.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Prirings are like that by nature, but these little ones were frustrated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They've been strongly influenced by succubi and try to charm others. I suspect they're frustrated because their charms don't work on you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A Curiring is saying something. Yes, yes. What's that? You're beautiful, not cute?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hoho. They sound just like Veled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled says that to you too?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha. Succubi certainly have different standards of beauty. But why do you look so tired?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The magic sack saves a lot of space, but apparently it doesn't reduce weight. Carrying dozens of Curirings is heavy work.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I see. My apologies. I seem to have forgotten to mention that. Oh, Curiring? What is it?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, yes, Curiring. Go on.
(The Curirings approach Atkina, crying, "Curi, curi, curiring." Atkina responds with a variety of expressions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All I hear is "curi, curi." What are they saying?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This Curiring says...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: "I can't keep a wonderful place like this to myself. I want to see my friends. Ask the fool who can't tell cute from beautiful to bring them too."

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: ...So it says.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've got some nerve asking a fool for a favor, you little rascal.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I never knew a Curiring's cheeks could stretch so far...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I rescue more Curirings, then?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There is one thing to be careful of. We can reverse some of the demonic transformation in the Curirings roaming outside, but...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Other varieties are dangerous. Bring only the ones you think can be saved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I tell?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The goddess will guide you. When you feel you've found the right one, put it in this sack and bring it here. This one should feel lighter than the previous sack.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: These originally came from Kali. Tremende brought them in its mouth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kali? Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wonder if Medea is all right...)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please be a little quicker this time. I'd like to finish before the new phantom beasts are born.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: We need to check the Curirings' condition and see whether they can live with the newborns.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go right away.
(Atkina examines the Curirings.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This won't hurt, so stay still. You little rascal! There, that's it...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, you're back. Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back. This sack really works well. It's light, sturdy, and holds a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, carrying it up the steep valley was tiring.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The valley is that way because I made hiding places for the phantom beasts. Now, give me the sack with the little ones. Hm? They're quieter than I expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I gave them some jerky I bought in Lumen. That quieted them down.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That jerky is just right for the little ones. It isn't to my taste, though...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, Lord Atkina...?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Come out, little ones.
(The Curirings emerge from the sack and look around. Spotting the Curirings already there, they tumble together and begin playing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow. They're even louder in a group.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It may take them a while to adjust to the change in surroundings. Still, this place should be better for them than anywhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They certainly look different here than they did in Phobos or elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perhaps they feel at ease... Ah, I have one more request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The phantom beasts are about to be born. They're sensitive to a human presence. Having you here could unsettle them.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even being the goddess's messenger cannot change that. I'm sorry. Would you go somewhere else for a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Go to Tartaros and see Shynic. Tell her new phantom beasts are being born and we've brought Curirings here. She may come if she'd like to see them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She'll be delighted. I'll go tell her.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. Off you go.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is there some reason you cannot speak with the adventurer?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Medea.
(Medea slowly steps out from behind a tree crowded with phantom beasts.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It has been a long time, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine. Are you... all right, Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There's no reason I wouldn't be. You're the one I'm worried about.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know this wasn't something you wanted. Say no more. First, we must deal with Weiss...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. A nonhuman like me has no right to speak that way. And for not intervening then because I considered it a human matter...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am sorry.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's all right. I only hope you won't take too long. Please understand this.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I don't know how much trust you feel you need, but the longer you delay, the greater the burden on the goddess's messenger becomes.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And %s is worried about you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I will remember that.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Good... Then return before Shynic arrives. You seemed to find her bothersome, so I'll erase your presence.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She isn't bothersome... I will return now. Thank you, Lord Atkina...
(Medea bows to Atkina and leaves. Watching her, Atkina gives a faint, relieved smile.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There's no need to worry. It seems the two of them have become friends...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm bored. So bored. Even eating feels like a chore today.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, today's menu is...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, I really can't be bothered today. Keep this up and I'll replace my butler♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hmm. I wonder if there's another butler who can make your favorite special curry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, listen to you, Melvic! You've grown bold. I raised you from this little thing into all that!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: All thanks to you, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, all thanks to me, right? Huh... %s, when did you get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shynic. Just now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. You smell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Sniff, sniff. I bathe regularly...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was going to say, "You smell like something terribly fun♡" But your reaction ruined it. Anyway, did you come from old Atkina's place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She already knew.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Lord Atkina asked me to tell you something. You see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Shynic about the newborn phantom beasts and the Curirings brought to the valley.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Curirings?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa. I've never seen her eyes sparkle this much.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Curirings that demons keep?! Where did you say they are?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We brought them to the Dragon Valley. Lord Atkina is going to raise them there...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow! I saw them hundreds of years ago and never again since. Those rare Curirings?!

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Will their wings and tails disappear if they're purified? That can't happen. Maybe I'll bring one home and raise it myself. I can treat it just as well as a demon could.
(Shynic seems unable to hear anything around her.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, I hate running, but I'm going to run all the way to the Dragon Valley!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, when will you eat your curry, then?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now!!
(Shynic snatches the plate from Melvic and hurriedly shovels the food into her mouth.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm off!
(No sooner has she spoken than Shynic races up Tartaros's walls toward Adrica.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm glad Lady Shynic is in better spirits. It's thanks to you, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't do anything...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: She seemed rather down after what happened recently, but she's been better since visiting Kali.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you for telling her about the Curirings, too.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Please keep visiting Tartaros and bringing interesting things into her life. It takes quite a lot to amuse her these days.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Oh, Lady Shynic mentioned you visited Mars recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I had something to do there...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I should visit sometime. See Peo, and perhaps arrange another butlers' gathering...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Peonia...)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I must excuse myself now. There are new items at the Hall of Heroes that need sorting. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck, Melvic. Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I feel a little strange... I should just rest. I've had so much to do lately. I'm tired.
